summary: Two issues at East Bus Substation: corrosion on east-bus insulator #3 is VISUAL — cited frame verified at 1024px re-extraction with a tracked SAM bbox — and transformer T4 oil level is VOICE ONLY, downgraded after the verification pass found no concrete visual confirmation. Remaining tracked assets show no reported defects.

defects.title: Corrosion on east bus insulator #3
defects.description: Reddish corrosion near the cap of the third insulator on the east bus, concretely visible in the cited key frame.
defects.voiceNoteExcerpt: The third insulator on the east bus has visible corrosion near the cap
defects.recommendedAction: Schedule replacement of insulator-003 within 30 days; treat as arc-flash risk until remediated.
defects.observation: Reddish corrosion is concretely visible near the cap of the third insulator on the east bus in the cited frame.

verification.reason: Cited frame concretely shows reddish corrosion near the cap of insulator-003; 1024px re-extraction confirms the claimed damage.

defects.title: Low oil level on transformer T4
defects.description: Inspector reports low oil level on transformer T4; verification pass found no concrete visual confirmation in the cited frame, so the finding is preserved as a voice-only note.
defects.voiceNoteExcerpt: Transformer T4 oil level looks low, marking for follow-up next visit
defects.recommendedAction: Verify oil level with gauge at next scheduled maintenance; top up if below threshold.
